body:
The backward playback logic has been changed. In its current state, this breaks backward compatibility, so it cannot be merged.

Previously, the timeline was reversed first, followed by trimming:
```
0s ABCDE 1s -backward-> 0s EDCBA 1s -custom length-> 0s EDC 0.5s
```
In this PR, that order has been changed:
```
0s ABCDE 1s -custom length-> 0s ABC 0.5s -backward-> 0s CBA 0.5s
```

While this order was not explicitly documented, compatibility must be maintained. Discrete is broken and should be fixed in this PR, but the behavior of Continuous keys should definitely not be changed before or after this PR.

This is my personal opinion, but considering the user’s input order, I believe it’s easier to calculate the duration if we reverse the playback first and then trim it. For example, if you want to play only the first 0.5 seconds of a reversed animation, you should simply enter 0.5 instead of subtracting the animation_length and end point with remembering animation_length on the user side.

Also, with that in mind, I noticed discrepancies in the feature that creates custom timelines from markers. I’m not sure if the marker list needs to be reversed, but this needs to be taken into account for reverse playback.

Thanks for your efforts. I think this is works well now.

We are currently in the beta phase, so this fix should be merged as soon as possible.

However, we need to be more careful when defining the behavior. While I believe the current behavior is fine, it might be better to put the test code in a separate PR and the test code PR is merged in 4.8 cycle just in case there are any errors.
